title: [Global Home - Header & Navigation Drawer] "Log in" Action Disappears on All Viewports <= 1439px (Laptop, Tablet & Mobile) With 222px Blank Header Space on Mobile & No Drawer Fallback
environment: Staging (STAG) · Laptop 1280×800 / 1366×768, Tablet 1024×768 / 768×1024, Mobile 430×932 / 390×844 / 375×667 · Chrome 145 · en-US (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/home)
steps_to_reproduce: Open https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/home in an unauthenticated (Guest) browser session at Desktop >= 1440×900 and verify the 'Log in' button (.gns-home-header-login, 92×44px) is visible in the top-right Header.
Resize the viewport to any screen width <= 1439px (e.g., Laptop 1280×800 or 1366×768, Tablet 768×1024, or Mobile 390×844) and inspect the Header bar.
Click the Hamburger Menu button (.gns-home-header-menu, aria-label='Open global navigation') to open <aside class='gns-home-drawer'> and inspect the 'Account' section.
Resize to Mobile <= 429px (e.g., 390×844 iPhone 14/15 or 375×667 iPhone SE) and measure getBoundingClientRect() + computed styles of .gns-home-header-utils in F12 DevTools.
actual_result:
- At all viewports <= 1439px (100% of 1366×768 and 1280×800 laptops, 1024×768 and 768×1024 tablets, and all mobile phones), CSS rule @media (max-width: 1439px) hides .gns-home-header-utils (width: 0px; flex: 0 0 0px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; transform: translate(12px)), making the Header 'Log in' button (.gns-home-header-login) completely invisible and unclickable.
- Inside the refactored Guest Navigation Drawer (<aside class='gns-home-drawer'>), the available controls are only ['Create Account Free', 'Accommodation', 'Support', 'English', 'USD $', 'Join as Partner', 'Help Center', 'About goodNstay']. Unlike the previous build where 'Account' contained a 'Log in' row above 'Support', 'Log in' has been omitted completely — leaving Guest users on <= 1439px devices with zero direct Login entry point on Global Home.
- Additionally, at @media (max-width: 429px) (Mobile), CSS overrides .gns-home-header-utils { flex: 1 1 auto; gap: 4px; min-width: 0px; margin-left: 0px; } — expanding .gns-home-header-utils to 222×48px of blank dead space on 390×844 (207×48px on 375×667) — while failing to reset opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: none.
expected_result:
- Guest users on every viewport (Laptop, Tablet, and Mobile <= 1439px) must always have a clear, accessible 'Log in' entry point — either visible in the Header on mobile/tablet or rendered as a primary action inside <aside class='gns-home-drawer'> under the 'Account' section (consistent with >= 1440px Desktop parity and Confluence Design & Responsive Standards 171376745).
- .gns-home-header-utils on <= 429px must either restore opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: none if intended to display utility controls, or remain collapsed without reserving an invisible unclickable 222×48px box.

evidence.console: 0 uncaught JS errors; DOM inspection confirms <button class='gns-home-header-login'> exists inside .gns-home-header-utils with ancestor computed opacity: 0 and pointer-events: none at <= 1439px, and zero login link/button exists inside .gns-home-drawer.
evidence.notes: Root Cause (CSS + JSX Regression on STAG): (1) @media (max-width: 1439px) sets .gns-home .gns-home-header-verticals, .gns-home .gns-home-header-utils { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; flex: 0 0 0px; width: 0px; overflow: hidden; transform: translate(12px); }. (2) @media (max-width: 429px) sets .gns-home .gns-home-header-utils { flex: 1 1 auto; } without resetting opacity/pointer-events/transform. (3) Refactored STAG Drawer JSX removed the Guest 'Log in' row under 'Account' (leaving only 'Create Account Free' and 'Support').

classification: Confirmed Bug — Critical UX / Responsive Regression (Missing Authentication Entry Point on <= 1439px)
